metrics.population: one filing, fixed 10-question regression set, not company-wide performance
metrics.answer_complete_definition: Numerator counts supported questions whose required source spans are fully covered. Denominator is only answer_complete_ceiling=true. Partial questions cannot reach a complete answer, so they are outside this denominator.
metrics.source_ceiling_definition: Required source spans are covered. For a partial question this is the document ceiling of the supported claims. It is not a complete answer and it does not measure abstention, because there is no generation layer.

metric_semantics.claim_set_recall: Headline. Required answer-valid claims fully covered by the top-k candidate set, over all required claims. Alternative evidence paths are not in this denominator. Numerator and denominator are both kept.
metric_semantics.question_evidence_satisfied: Legacy question-level AND of those required claims. Not the OR of evidence paths.
metric_semantics.answer_evidence_path_recall: Diagnostic, not a headline. Each positive question contributes exactly one selected evidence path. The first fully covered path wins; otherwise the path with the highest claim-set coverage wins, and declared order breaks ties. The denominator is the sum of selected-path claim counts, so it can change with the path that is selected.
metric_semantics.question_answer_evidence_satisfied: Headline. A positive question succeeds when at least one allowed evidence path is fully covered in the top-k set. Paths are OR, not AND. Denominator is the positive question count. Q09 is excluded as a paraphrase and Q10 is excluded as out of scope.
metric_semantics.relevant_conflict_hit: Diagnostic only. Numerator is questions whose labeled relevant_conflicting element appears at rank <= k. Denominator is questions that carry that label. A higher value is not better and a lower value is not better.
metric_semantics.deterministic_calculation: Q07 calculation_q07 is a separate test. It uses the derived operand path and is not added into retrieval recall.
